instruction: Keep going to the next song on Spotify until you reach a song by Lily Moon.
notes: The music-player queue is unknown at planning time, so it is abstracted as a short chain of song placeholders (current-song-0 -> queued-song-1 -> lily-moon-song) linked by the static queue-next relation; the resulting plan exhibits the next_song / show_current_song loop body twice, and at runtime the loop simply repeats until show_current_song reports an artist id equal to the one returned by search_artists. The initial song is marked as already inspected because the instruction requires advancing at least once before checking; next_song then requires the current song to have been inspected and clears that flag, forcing a show_current_song after every advance. Only the cursor moves (no play/pause), matching the evaluation which allows only MusicPlayer.cursor_position to change. supervisor-complete-task carries the reached song and target artist as non-API record parameters so its precondition can state the goal (cursor on a song confirmed to be by the looked-up Lily Moon artist id); no answer is passed since the task is not a question. search_artists needs no access token in the API, so the search action has no token precondition.
